caseNameFull: PHOTOS ETC. CORP. v. HOME DEPOT U.S.A., INC.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

THE CHIEF JUSTICE and Justice ALITO took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
